description: Validates the User Hub homepage and Sessions tab, including a visual inspection of the sessions view.

steps.title: Open the User Hub
steps.description: Opens the User Hub via the command palette. The hub should appear with the default Sessions tab active.
steps.expectedInput: Plugin enabled, no User Hub open
steps.expectedOutput: User Hub is visible with Sessions tab selected

actions.label: homepage
actions.description: User Hub homepage with Sessions tab

steps.title: Inspect Sessions tab

actions.prompt: Verify the Sessions tab renders correctly: session list is visible, columns are aligned, and the layout looks clean.
